name: Mardu
description: The Mardu are the warlike horde clan of Tarkir, led by hordechiefs and khans, in which Sarkhan once served as a wing leader.

timeline.summary: Flashback: Sarkhan grows up among the Mardu Horde as a feared battle mage and wing leader, scorching clans of the hinterlands.
timeline.quote: Talent with battle magic, and natural ferocity, made me feared among the Horde.

citation.text: "The Madness of Sarkhan" by Jennifer Clarke Wilkes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Sep 2014.

timeline.summary: Flashback: Sarkhan returns and the hordechief Zurgo demands his obedience, sending him against the Sultai.
timeline.quote: The Helmsmasher grudgingly sent me forth with a wing of riders to challenge the Sultai

citation.text: "The Madness of Sarkhan" by Jennifer Clarke Wilkes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Sep 2014.

timeline.summary: The patrol finds a shepherds' summer camp destroyed, with every villager killed, and Riza orders the dead buried, fearing the horde of at least one hundred that did it.
timeline.quote: The small village lay in utter desolation. No survivors were left.

citation.text: "The Salt Road" by Jeremiah Isgur. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Nov 2014.

timeline.summary: The Mardu hordechief feasts on the loot and has his advisors plan the next raid while privately hiding his own self-doubt.
timeline.quote: The shepherds will be moving their flocks north to the villages for winter.

citation.text: "The Salt Road" by Jeremiah Isgur. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Nov 2014.

timeline.summary: The hordechief orders an immediate attack on the Abzan patrol and cuts off the tip of the quartermaster's finger when she questions him.
timeline.quote: who quickly snatched it, drew his knife, and sliced the tip off the pinky finger before she could react.

citation.text: "The Salt Road" by Jeremiah Isgur. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Nov 2014.

timeline.summary: The Mardu horde rides through the night; the Abzan spy buzzard reports it is turning to engage and will arrive before noon.
timeline.quote: The horde has turned south to engage us,

citation.text: "The Salt Road" by Jeremiah Isgur. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Nov 2014.

timeline.summary: The hordechief hides his doubts about the gamble, believing he cannot show weakness if he wants to remain hordechief.
timeline.quote: To change course would be a sign of uncertainty.

citation.text: "The Salt Road" by Jeremiah Isgur. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Nov 2014.

timeline.summary: The Mardu horde nears the oasis; the Abzan form a shield wall and endure a barrage of arrows.
timeline.quote: The air hummed with the flight of arrows.

citation.text: "The Salt Road" by Jeremiah Isgur. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Nov 2014.

timeline.summary: The Mardu horde splits in two to attack both ends of the canyon, and the hordechief glimpses an Abzan siege elephant tower.
timeline.quote: He rose in his saddle just in time to see the tower of the Abzan siege elephant poking through the haze in the distance…

citation.text: "The Salt Road" by Jeremiah Isgur. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Nov 2014.

timeline.summary: Sidisi resolves never again to show mercy and plans to raise a vast army to destroy the Mardu and humiliate Zurgo.
timeline.quote: Soon, the great orc Zurgo himself would adorn her palace as her greatest prize.

citation.text: "Mercy" by Sam Stoddard. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Nov 2014.

timeline.summary: Zurgo surveys the Mardu army after defeating a Temur force and rallies it with a victory speech.
timeline.quote: Surrak has tested our borders," he shouted, "and we have shown him that they are strong.

citation.text: "Victory" by Tom LaPille. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Nov 2014.

timeline.summary: Unnatural snow falls as the Mardu enter the mountain valley, and Batar urges Zurgo to turn back.
timeline.quote: My khan, we must turn back. This is absurd. We are riding into a trap.

citation.text: "Victory" by Tom LaPille. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Nov 2014.

timeline.summary: Temur raiders strike the center of the Mardu line twice and vanish into the woods, killing over a hundred Mardu.
timeline.quote: Fifty Temur arranged in a column broke into our line, killed fifty-six, and disappeared back into the woods.

citation.text: "Victory" by Tom LaPille. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Nov 2014.

timeline.summary: Zurgo gives three young warriors new names for their first kills: Headtaker, Heartpiercer, and Neckwringer.
timeline.quote: Headtaker," Zurgo decreed.

citation.text: "Victory" by Tom LaPille. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Nov 2014.

timeline.summary: Varuk declares that Zurgo's horde fears him rather than serves him, and the horde follows Varuk home to Wingthrone, abandoning Zurgo.
timeline.quote: They once served you. Now they only fear you. And that means that you are not truly their khan.

citation.text: "Victory" by Tom LaPille. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Nov 2014.

timeline.summary: Alesha leads the Mardu horde in an ambush of six dragons from Kolaghan's brood in a canyon.
timeline.quote: Her arrow struck the first one in the mouth, sending a stray bolt of lightning harmlessly to the ground.

citation.text: "The Truth of Names" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Jan 2015.

timeline.summary: Mardu warriors drop from a bluff onto the swerving dragon and two drive swords deep into its flesh.
timeline.quote: But two Mardu—two who would be celebrated this night—drove swords into its flesh

citation.text: "The Truth of Names" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Jan 2015.

timeline.summary: A towering nameless orc stuns a dragon but holds back instead of killing it, and Gedruk Wingbreaker delivers the killing blow.
timeline.quote: It was Gedruk Wingbreaker who ran forward and hacked at the creature's neck before it could regain its balance.

citation.text: "The Truth of Names" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Jan 2015.

timeline.summary: In a flashback, sixteen-year-old Alesha kills her first dragon with a spear and names herself Alesha, her grandmother's name, before the old khan and the horde.
timeline.quote: she pulled a spear from a dead man's back and plunged it into the beast's mouth, up into its brain.

citation.text: "The Truth of Names" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Jan 2015.

timeline.summary: In the flashback, the old khan and horde shout Alesha's name without hesitation.
timeline.quote: And the whole gathered horde shouted "Alesha!" in reply.

citation.text: "The Truth of Names" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Jan 2015.

timeline.summary: The orc fights unorthodoxly, battering the dragon and making openings for allies, and the six dragons die at great cost.
timeline.quote: Six of Kolaghan's brood would never prey on the Mardu again.

citation.text: "The Truth of Names" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Jan 2015.

timeline.summary: After the battle, Alesha hears the warriors' deeds and shouts out each new war name.
timeline.quote: she shouted the name for the horde to hear—with never a moment's hesitation.

citation.text: "The Truth of Names" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Jan 2015.

timeline.summary: The orc declares he knows Alesha and names her 'Alesha, Who Smiles at Death,' and the Mardu shout her name.
timeline.quote: and I call you Alesha, Who Smiles at Death.

citation.text: "The Truth of Names" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Jan 2015.

timeline.summary: A bell rings from a Mardu camp and an ancient dragon leads a herd of dragons up to meet Sarkhan; he sees the other timeline's rotting skull in her face.
timeline.quote: Shooting toward him was both the dragon of this now, flesh and blood and scales, and the dragon of the now that had been lost forever

citation.text: "A Tarkir of Dragons" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Feb 2015.

timeline.summary: A Sultai noble tells the Mardu engineer how a hungry Mardu boy killed her for two days of rice.
timeline.quote: He killed me for two days' worth of rice.

citation.work: Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Episode 1: Stories and Their Bones
citation.text: "Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Episode 1: Stories and Their Bones " by Cassandra Khaw. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Mar 2025.

timeline.summary: Wounded and humiliated, Sarkhan limps back to his hut in Mardu territory, mourning his lost power.
timeline.quote: He walked for hours from the Crucible to the cold fields of Mardu territory.

citation.work: Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Episode 3: What the Past Devours
citation.text: "Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Episode 3: What the Past Devours" by Cassandra Khaw. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Mar 2025.

timeline.summary: Paala remembers how a Mardu hunting party found her family and took them in, and how her mother came to tend their manul kittens.
timeline.quote: a Mardu hunting party that had been tasked with scouting and following the storm had stumbled across the three of them

citation.work: Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Mardu: Where Lightning Tells Our Story
citation.text: "Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Mardu: Where Lightning Tells Our Story" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Mar 2025.

timeline.summary: Emina and the elders affirm that Paala reached the lightning first and was kind to her peers.
timeline.quote: Paala was the first to reach the summit,

relations.quote: a former Mardu who burned his own clanmates with dragonfire when his spark ignited.

relations.note: She is the Mardu khan at nineteen.

relations.note: The dragon the Mardu revere for speed.

citation.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Fate Reforged". Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jan 2015.

relations.note: She is the young khan of the Mardu.
relations.quote: The young khan of the Mardu sat poised at the front of her horde

citation.text: "The Truth of Names" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Jan 2015.
